elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: 11.1 On expiry or termination Vendor shall continue transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days (running from expiry/termination, not a later request)
elements.evidence: 11.2 Within 30 days after expiry or termination, Vendor shall return all Customer Data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: complete, commonly used, documented, standard machine-readable format

elements.element: Deletion of remaining Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: After Customer confirms successful return, Vendor shall securely delete remaining Customer Data
An authorized officer shall certify deletion in writing.
continue transition assistance for up to 6 months (exceeds 90 days)
Within 30 days after expiry or termination, Vendor shall return all Customer Data

reasons: All four preferred atomic duties are express in operative text: 6-month assistance window, then-current rates, 30-day return in a standard machine-readable format anchored to expiry or termination, and deletion followed by officer certification.
The former request-condition was removed so the 30-day return obligation is mandatory rather than triggered by a Customer request; 11.3's deletion-and-certification sequence remains untouched.

Edits are confined to two sentences (flipping 11.1's discontinuation/deletion and re-anchoring 11.2's deadline and format word); no new exceptions, undefined terms, or dangling mechanics are introduced, and the fee-dispute non-withholding and retained-copy protections survive.
